## Tech workers

Adopt regret as a metric: instrument one honest signal of whether users are glad, a week later, for the time they gave you. Design one feature *for the off-screen life* — something whose success is measured by what happens away from the product. Then grade your product against the ten Christian design principles and pick the weakest to improve.
